title: Signature Battle Skill in RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: taylorjay007
posts.body:
I've tried to search over the forum for this and found several answers for RMMV but have been having trouble finding a RMMZ compatible answer.
I want to give each of my actors a signature battle skill (think Cecil's Darkness or Kain's Jump from FFIV) that I would want to appear in the main battle menu (instead of being nestled inside the magic or special menus). I'm using mostly VS plugins so far so I like to try to stay in that family if I can to make sure things are compatible, but I'm not seeing an option for this in any of the VS plugins (if I am dumb and totally missing it I'm sorry). If anyone knows of a way to make this work, I would really appreciate a point in the right direction.

Greetings!
This can absolutely be done using Visustella's Battle Core.
All you need to do is use the <Battle Commands> notetag.
Apply that to a class in the database, then list the commands you want them to use.
Create a skill that is your command, like Jump.
Then have Skill: Jump (or Skill: 87 if Jump is ID 87) in your list of battle commands.
That's all there is to it, Jump will show up in the class' command window, the same as Attack, or Guard.
Happy game making,
-Niniann
